headline: In the Mekong Delta, a push to grow food with saltwater
description: A look at how farmers are adapting crop choices and water practices to saltwater intrusion, climate pressure, and changing river conditions.

headline: Statement by IMF Deputy Managing Director Nigel Clarke at the Conclusion of His Visit to Colombia
description: The IMF’s Colombia statement discusses economic resilience, fiscal priorities, infrastructure gaps, and investment in energy and skills.

headline: How Peru Can Use a New Commodity Boom to Durably Lift Growth
description: The IMF considers how Peru could channel mineral revenues into stronger public investment and more durable, inclusive growth.

headline: Latin America Seeks to Transform Its Mineral Wealth into Jobs and Development
description: A regional dialogue examines ways to turn mineral resources into employment, infrastructure, innovation, and local development.

headline: World Bank to Build Flood Resilience and Protect Jobs in Brazil's Santa Catarina State
description: A proposed resilience project in Santa Catarina combines flood-control infrastructure with expanded early-warning capacity.
